text: I am updating the Marrow Fieldworks file. What do we have on the Gatehouse Check-In report timeout at Salina North, and on the West yard Door 2 double-booking?
reply_text:
I've replied to you in our DM. Both issues have ticket numbers, but I couldn't find a current status for either one. I only looked in places you can see yourself: #central-team, #central-random and the shared notes.

1. Gatehouse Check-In report timeout at Salina North: this is ticket #4409. A Central handoff note from 2 Jan 2026 says you flagged it before Marrow Fieldworks changed hands on Monday 5 Jan. The timeout kept coming back at Bay 4 and the west grain-bin apron during the 06:00 flatbed intake. The same note lists ticket #4412, a small driver SMS prompt glitch when combine trailers are staged on unpaved overflow lots. I found nothing later on #4409. That note shows up in the knowledge base, but I couldn't open the file itself in the shared folders.

2. West yard Door 2 double-booking: Tobias raised it in #central-random on 13 Oct. Door 2 was still double-booking when flatbeds checked in early at the kiosk, even after the webhook patch, and he logged it with support on ticket #8841. Nobody has posted since about whether it's fixed.

Neither source names Marrow Fieldworks outright. The handoff note says "Pree's dealer account" and your 13 Oct message calls it "Tobias's dealer account". From those I'm assuming it's Marrow Fieldworks and that it passed from Pree to Tobias on 5 Jan, so please check that before it goes in the file. Also keep these separate from the Marrow Agrisupply tickets (PD-4821 and FR-882). Tobias is the one to ask for the latest on #4409 and #8841.
